idea.title: Weekly remote jobs newsletter on beehiiv, sponsor-funded

source.text: A weekly newsletter of remote jobs on beehiiv, free for readers, paid by sponsors. Launch country US, budget $500, 6 hours a week, goal side income, no special edge. Just go: do not ask questions.

idea.customer: Readers looking for remote jobs (free); sponsors pay
idea.solution: A weekly newsletter of remote jobs on beehiiv
claims: free for readers, paid by sponsors
assumptions: Readers are US job seekers wanting fully remote roles, all job types
Sponsors buy at a career-newsletter CPM of about $30 per 1,000 opens (range $14-50)
40% open rate, half the weekly slots sold (fill rate 50%)
Monthly reader churn 8%, because readers leave once hired
The $500 goes to beehiiv paid recommendations, the only paid lever that fits the budget

confidence.note: Real churn and fill rates from a live remote-jobs newsletter's media kit would raise it

gross_margin.note: About **85%**: beehiiv is near-fixed cost; unsold slots leak. Capped by R4

ltv_cac.note: LTV ~$0.26 per reader vs $1.63 paid CAC: **0.16**. R4 applied

pricing_power.note: Readers pay $0; sponsors buy at market CPM ($14-50), no premium. Lowered by R4

build_effort.note: beehiiv template plus a curated list: live in **1 day**, no code

skills_match.note: Curation and copy are learnable; growth and sponsor sales are the hard part

capital_needed.note: Free Launch plan to 2,500 subs; Scale ~$49/month fits the $500

time_to_mvp.note: First issue can ship this week

sales_cycle.note: Ad Network needs **1,000 active subs** first; then pitch sponsors

channel_readiness.note: No audience; paid subs cost more than they earn; Reddit is a one-off kick. R5

search_demand.note: About **1.1M** monthly Google searches for remote jobs (global)

trend.note: Seeker interest flat at 9-10% since 2022; remote postings 8.9% (Feb 2026)

willingness_to_pay.note: Readers expect free; sponsors do pay incumbents ($1,000/issue at Working Nomads)

free_alternatives.note: LinkedIn, Indeed and Working Nomads send free remote alerts. R1

competitor_density.note: 12+ remote-job newsletters and boards, incl. Remotive at 280k readers

differentiation.note: No niche and no edge stated: a generic list

legal_regulatory.note: CAN-SPAM and FTC sponsor disclosure: basic compliance only

platform_dependency.note: beehiiv owns pricing (new plans 2026-10) but the list is exportable

market_risk.note: Remote share tracks the hiring cycle; scam postings threaten reader trust

skills.note: No stated recruiting, media or sales experience

assets.note: No audience, data or network: user states no edge

interest.note: Goal stated as side income, i.e. for the money

tam.reasoning: Global newsletter ad billings $2.4B (IAB, via Voxbooster 2026); one tertiary source only, so estimate

sam.reasoning: $2.4B x 2% career/jobs share (assumed) x 50% US share (assumed)

som.reasoning: Bottom-up base case: 3,000 subs x 40% opens x $30 CPM = $36/issue x 2 sold/month x 12; far below 0.1% of SAM ($24k) because audience is the limit

competitors_found.reasoning: Remotive, We Work Remotely, Working Nomads, Remote OK, FlexJobs, NoDesk, Real Work From Anywhere, RatRaceRebellion, NoCommute, Remote Weekly, Startremote, Premotely

competitor_price_range.value: $549-$1,000 per sponsor slot or job post; seekers $23.95/4 weeks
competitor_price_range.reasoning: Working Nomads $1,000/issue, Remote OK $549/post, FlexJobs $23.95/4 weeks

demand_trend.reasoning: Seeker interest 9-10% since 2022; postings 8.1% -> 8.9% to Feb 2026

price.reasoning: 4 issues x 40% opens x $30 CPM / 1000 x 50% fill = $0.024; CPM range $14 (SenderCircle) to $50 (Influencerfee)

variable_cost_per_unit.reasoning: beehiiv Scale ~$290-329/month at 75k-100k subs = ~$0.0035 per sub per month

churn_monthly_pct.reasoning: Assumed: job seekers unsubscribe once hired; no sourced benchmark found

conversion_rate_pct.reasoning: Assumed landing-page sign-up rate; readers pay nothing, so the paying customer is the sponsor

cac.reasoning: beehiiv paid recommendations average $1.63; a second beehiiv example shows $2.00

payback_months.reasoning: 1.63 / (0.024 x 0.85 = 0.0204) = 80 months, longer than the 12.5-month lifetime

fixed_costs_month.reasoning: beehiiv Scale entry price; Launch is $0 up to 2,500 subs

break_even_customers_per_month.reasoning: $49 / $0.0204 gross profit per sub per month = 2,402 subscribers

time_to_first_revenue_weeks.reasoning: Reach 1,000 subs (Ad Network minimum) at ~60/week organic at 6 h/week, then 1-2 weeks to sell a first slot

verdict.launch_reason: The user's stated launch market; US sponsors pay the highest newsletter CPMs.

rules_applied.effect: free LinkedIn/Indeed alerts, no edge: free_alternatives 1.5 -> 1, competition mean 1.17
no channel and LTV:CAC 0.16: total 56 capped at 49

verdict.cheapest_test: 7 days: niche beehiiv page for remote HR/recruiting jobs, 3 community posts, 20 employer emails offering a $99 featured listing
kill_criteria: fewer than 100 subscribers by day 7 -> stop
0 of 20 employers pre-pay a $99 listing by day 7 -> stop
open rate below 35% on issue 1 -> stop

rescue.change: Go niche and sell employer-paid featured listings ($99) to one B2B vertical, e.g. remote HR and recruiting roles
rescue.why: Fixes ltv_cac and differentiation: employers pay per post, HR lists earn ~15x lifestyle ad rates
rescue.requires: Learning one niche well enough to curate it and pitch its employers

rescue.change: Charge readers $5/month for a verified, scam-free remote list (FlexJobs model), free tier as funnel
rescue.why: Fixes pricing_power: seekers already pay FlexJobs $23.95/4 weeks to avoid scams
rescue.effort: 2 weeks to set up paid tier
rescue.requires: A vetting routine you can sustain in 6 h/week

narrative.answer: **NO-GO.** A generic sponsor-paid remote-jobs newsletter earns about **$0.26 per reader** but a paid reader costs $1.63, free LinkedIn and Indeed alerts do the job, and 280k-reader incumbents own the sponsors.
tldr: Unit economics are upside down: **LTV:CAC 0.16** on the only paid channel the $500 can buy.
Free remote alerts from LinkedIn, Indeed and Working Nomads cover the **whole job**.
At a base case of 3,000 readers it nets about **$23/month**, under $1 an hour for 6 h/week.

key_findings.title: Each reader costs 6x what it earns
key_findings.detail: beehiiv paid recommendations average **$1.63** per subscriber; a reader is worth about $0.26 over 12.5 months.

key_findings.title: Free alerts already do the job
key_findings.detail: Working Nomads, LinkedIn and Indeed send **free** remote job alerts daily or weekly.

key_findings.title: Incumbents own the sponsor budget
key_findings.detail: Remotive sells sponsors a **280,000+** reader list; Working Nomads charges $1,000 per issue.

narrative.recommendation: **Archive** the generic version; spend 7 days testing the niche, employer-paid variant before writing a single issue.
narrative.steelman: Remote job interest is durable (seeker share **9-10%** since 2022) and sponsors already pay incumbents $1,000 an issue, so a list that reaches ~20k readers can earn. The evidence: getting there took incumbents years and needs an edge the user lacks.
narrative.lesson: An audience business with no audience and no edge is a CAC problem, not a content problem.

free_alternative.evidence: Working Nomads, LinkedIn and Indeed send **free** remote job alerts with a remote filter (2026).

strong_competitor.evidence: Remotive's newsletter reaches **280,000+** readers; Real Work From Anywhere has about 24,000 subscribers (2026).

graveyard.evidence: Privacy-first Jobs closed because traffic and subscribers **never grew**; WantRemoteJob closed for lack of time.

no_distribution.evidence: Paid readers cost **$1.63** on beehiiv vs ~$0.26 lifetime value; Reddit growth is a one-off kick-start, not a channel.

costs_eat_margin.evidence: Clear: beehiiv is free to 2,500 subs and ~$49/month after, so gross margin is about **85%**.

weak_demand.evidence: Clear: seeker interest in remote is stable at **9-10%** since 2022 and remote postings rose to 8.9% in Feb 2026.

legal_platform_risk.evidence: Clear: CAN-SPAM plus FTC sponsor disclosure are routine; searched beehiiv terms and US newsletter law, no blocker.

saturated_wave.evidence: Clear: searched Product Hunt and found 7 look-alikes (Remote Weekly, Startremote, Premotely...), but **not 10** dated in the last 12 months.

customer.segment: US job seekers wanting fully remote roles (readers) and remote-hiring tools, job boards and career services (sponsors)
customer.pain: Remote roles are about 9% of postings and scam listings are common
customer.today: Free LinkedIn and Indeed alerts, or FlexJobs at $23.95 every 4 weeks

use_cases.name: Generic weekly remote jobs list, sponsor-paid
Niche B2B remote jobs list with $99 employer featured posts

scenarios.name: Pessimistic
scenarios.note: Stalls at ~800 readers on the free plan; never reaches the 1,000 Ad Network floor

scenarios.name: Optimistic
scenarios.note: 10,000 readers, every weekly slot sold at $120: ~$381/month net

risks.risk: Never reaches 1,000 readers, so no sponsor can be sold
risks.mitigation: Pick a niche with a reachable community before launch

risks.risk: A scam posting slips into an issue and breaks reader trust
risks.mitigation: Only list jobs from company career pages

risks.risk: Missing sponsor disclosure under FTC and CAN-SPAM rules
risks.mitigation: Label every sponsor block at the top
Stay on the free plan until 2,500 readers

test_plan.step: Pick one niche (remote HR and recruiting roles) and build a beehiiv landing page with 10 hand-checked jobs
test_plan.verify: page live, 10 jobs from company career pages

test_plan.step: Post the list as value in 3 niche communities (no link spam)
Email 20 hiring managers in the niche offering a $99 featured listing in issue 1
test_plan.verify: at least 2 paid or written yes
100+ subs and 2+ paid listings, or stop

premortem.cause: The list stalled under 1,000 readers, so no sponsor could be sold.
premortem.early_signal: fewer than 150 subscribers after 30 days of community posts

premortem.cause: Sponsor CPMs paid less than the beehiiv bill plus Boosts spend.
premortem.early_signal: 0 replies to the first 20 sponsor pitches

premortem.cause: Readers went back to free LinkedIn and Indeed alerts.

changes.what: Free AI agents now find remote jobs for seekers (Writing.io Job Agent)
AI auto-apply agents launch for job seekers (CareerBoom)
beehiiv new plans and higher prices for new customers
US remote posting share rebounds to 8.9% from 8.1%

why_now.note: AI agents commoditise job curation and incumbents hold the audience: the window for a generic list is **closing**.

icp.who: Sponsors: remote-hiring tools, job boards and career services buying US remote job-seeker attention
where: Sponsor pages of incumbent lists (Working Nomads, Remotive)
icp.trigger: A product launch or a hiring push that needs remote candidates
